what: On one screen the Round has three different lengths and two different leg lists. A new user's hero lists 6 legs, 'about 24 minutes'. Today's plan says 'The Round · 25 min'. Tapping Start opens the builder with only 3 legs ticked, 'Start · 14 min', because roundCap() defaults to 15 while SLOT_MIN.free is 25. With due patterns and a weak step: hero 29 min with 7 legs (no weak leg), plan 25 min, builder 15 min with 8 legs on offer.
evidence: Fresh state at 390×844: hero 'about 24 minutes', plan 'The Round 25 min', builder ticks [0,1,1,1,0,0], 'Start · 14 min'. Seeded state: hero 29 min / 7 legs; builder 8 legs, 'Start · 15 min'. Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-first-phone.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T01-builder-phone.png
fix: Use one source of truth. Build the default selection once (presetLegs(roundCatalog(), roundCap())), show exactly those legs and that total in the hero, and pass the same minutes to the plan item. Make roundCap() default to SLOT_MIN[slot] (25 on a free day), not 15.

what: Skipping every leg counts as a finished Round. It gives +40 XP, sets lastRound, increments roundsDone, starts the streak, plays confetti and shows the 'Round complete' hero, all without answering a single question.
evidence: Fresh state: Start the Round → Start · 14 min → press 'Skip leg' 3 times. Result: S.lastRound='2026-11-13', roundsDone=1, xp=40, streak()=1, hero 'ROUND COMPLETE · Done for today.'
fix: Track per-leg outcome (ROUND.legs[i].skipped=true). In roundFinish, award the bonus, set lastRound and call touchDay only if at least one leg was actually done (e.g. ≥ half). Otherwise toast 'Round ended. Nothing was finished, so today is still open.'

what: The 'Go' button on the Round bar restarts the current leg, which throws away the answers already given in it. It is shown during the leg, next to 'Skip leg', so it is easy to tap.
evidence: Round leg 1 (gym): answer 2 items (SS.res.length=2), tap Go → SS.res.length=0, a fresh 5-sum gym.
fix: Show 'Go' only when VIEW is not already the leg's view, and call it 'Resume'. In roundGo, if SS && SS.round && !SS.done && the leg is a session, just go('session') instead of startSession again. Do the same for est/web/teach (only navigate).

what: The builder sheet is not keyboard-usable as a dialog. Esc does not close it (the generic sheet() has an Esc handler, openRoundBuilder does not). Focus stays on #tRound behind the scrim, so Tab moves through the Today page underneath. There is no aria-modal. After Cancel, focus falls to <body>.
evidence: Desktop 1280×800: focus #tRound, Enter → sheet open, activeElement=tRound; Tab → 'OUTSIDE The Round' (plan button); Escape → sheet still open; Cancel → activeElement BODY.
fix: Add role=dialog aria-modal=true aria-labelledby. On open, focus the first checkbox (or the Start button). Trap Tab inside .sheet, close on Escape (and on Back, see the next finding), and on close return focus to #tRound.

what: Pressing Android/browser Back while the Round builder is open closes the whole app instead of the sheet.
evidence: #today fresh → tap Start the Round → go_back() → about:blank.
fix: When the sheet opens, history.pushState({sheet:1},''). On popstate with a sheet open, close it, and on Cancel/Start call history.back() to consume the entry. Apply the same to the hand-kit sheet() in ui1.js.

what: The A–a verdict uses age/4 + 9 as the cut-off ('upper limit with tolerance'), so gradients between age/4+4 and age/4+9 are called 'normal'. That contradicts the app's own rule (A–a ≤ age/4 + 4) printed in the same sentence. 62 of 516 generated A–a items (12%) were labelled 'normal' although above the app's limit.
evidence: Simulated 3,000 estNew() calls in page.evaluate. Example: 'PaCO₂ 45, PaO₂ 68, age 78 … A–a = 25. Expected ≤ 24 for age 78 (upper limit with tolerance 29): normal.'
fix: Judge against age/4+4: `(a>age/4+4?'raised.':'normal.')`. Drop the '(upper limit with tolerance …)' phrase, or say 'borderline' for values within 5 above the limit.

what: The node text 'HAGMA with Winter's compensation; potassium before insulin.' teaches a blanket rule. Potassium comes before insulin only when K⁺ < 3.5 mmol/L (ADA 2024 consensus). JBDS starts fixed-rate insulin at once and adds K⁺ to the fluids. The Shifts DKA step and the flash card kacid-1 get this right, so the web contradicts them.
evidence: Concept web → DKA. Source: Umpierrez et al., Diabetes Care 2024 (summarised in CCJM 92(3):152): insulin 'should be postponed until a potassium level higher than 3.5 mmol/L is reached'.
fix: Change it to 'HAGMA with Winter's compensation; check K⁺ first and hold insulin if K⁺ < 3.5.'

what: The correct answer and its explanation call pH 7.44 'alkalaemic again' and say 'alkalinisation is doing its job'. pH 7.44 is within the normal range, not alkalaemia. The usual serum target during alkalinisation is pH 7.45–7.55, so the target has not yet been reached.
evidence: SERIES asa pts[2]: g {pH 7.44, PCO₂ 30, HCO₃⁻ 20}. Correct option: 'Better: alkalaemic again with a closing gap'.
fix: Either set pH to about 7.48 with HCO₃⁻ about 22, or reword to 'Better: pH back up and the gap closing. Keep the serum pH at 7.45–7.55 and the urine pH ≥ 7.5.'

what: The completion branch writes S.scen and calls addXP() on every render. Going away and back (or anything that re-renders the view) re-awards the XP and overwrites the saved date.
evidence: openScenario('co'); SC.i=steps.length; RENDER.scen(); then go('today'), go('scen') twice: XP 30 → 90.
fix: Award XP and save once, in the Next handler that moves past the last step (or guard with SC.saved=true). Keep the best run (fewest wrong turns) in S.scen rather than overwriting it.

where: RENDER.progress Accuracy by step; ui1.js STEPNAME.boss
what: In Quiet mode 'Boss questions' appears as a row in 'Accuracy by step' and in its hint. Module-check multiple-choice questions are not a step of reading a gas. 'Which gas fits' and 'Serial gases' are mixed in as well. Their hint says 'Hints for this step stay open / are behind a tap', which means nothing for these modes.
evidence: Seeded steps.boss → row 'Boss questions 90% 10'. Hold the row: bubble 'Boss questions / 90% over your recent attempts … Hints for this step are now behind a tap.' (Quiet mode on).
fix: Split the card: 'Steps of a read' (real…ox, cause, whatif) and 'Other drills' (fit, serial, module checks). Rename STEPNAME.boss to 'Module check questions' (or make it Quiet-aware). Only add the hint sentence for steps that have hints.

what: Gas sense's 'Estimate the expected PCO₂' items stay in mmHg in kPa mode: the slider is labelled 'Your guess 30 mmHg', the range is 10–50 and the tolerance reads '± 3 mmHg'. The pH items do convert ('PCO₂ 8.1 kPa'). Flash cards show 'Acute ΔpH per 10 mmHg' with no kPa form.
evidence: With S.units='kPa', go('est') until a PCO₂ item appears: 'Estimate the expected PCO₂ (mmHg) … Your guess 30 mmHg … Within ± 3 mmHg'. Screenshot of a pH item: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-est-kpa.png.
fix: In estNew/RENDER.est, generate and show PCO₂ in S.units (slider 1.3–6.7 kPa, step 0.1, tolerance ±0.4 kPa) and score in mmHg internally. For flash 'per 10 mmHg' rules, add '(per 1.3 kPa)' in kPa mode.

where: openRoundBuilder() draw(): checkbox onchange and preset [data-p] onclick
what: Toggling a leg checkbox with Space, or pressing a preset (Quick 10 / Standard 25 / Everything) with Enter, calls draw(), which rewrites sc.innerHTML. Focus is lost to <body>, so a keyboard user must Tab from the top of the page after every tick. The builder is also not a usable modal (see the next finding).
evidence: kb3.py: focus .sheet input[type=checkbox], press Space -> activeElement BODY. Focus [data-p="10"], press Enter -> BODY.
fix: Do not rebuild the sheet on change. Update only the checkbox states and the "Start · N min" label and disabled state of #rbBuild in place. Or, if draw() stays, re-focus the element with the same data-i or data-p after draw().

what: Round builder dialog: focus is not moved into it (it stays on #tRound behind the scrim), and Tab walks out to the page behind it. Escape does not close it. It has no aria-modal, and its title is a <b>, not a heading. Cancel or Build removes the sheet without returning focus to #tRound, so focus falls to <body>.
evidence: kb.py: Enter on #tRound -> focus still on #tRound and the next Tabs go to "The Round", "Real printouts"… behind the scrim. Escape -> the sheet is still open. Enter on #rbCancel -> activeElement BODY.
fix: Use the shared modal helper (see the ui1.js finding): role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby pointing at an <h2>; on open, focus the first preset button or the heading (tabindex=-1); trap Tab and Shift+Tab inside .sheet; close on Escape; on close, restore focus to the opener (#tRound, or the round-bar button that opened it); set inert on <main>, the header and #roundbar while it is open.

what: The builder always says 'Your weakest step comes first.', even when there is no weak leg (a new user, or fewer than 3 attempts per step). With a Citrus plan whose minutes are missing it shows 'Citrus planned  min.'
evidence: Fresh state: note shown, no 'Weakest step' row. G.plan={status:'none'} → 'Citrus planned  min.'
fix: Show the weak-step sentence only when weakLeg() is not null. Show the Citrus sentence only when +G.plan.minutes>0 and G.plan.status==='accepted'. Say 'capped at N min for today's shift' when the slot reduced it.

what: When the weakest step is Compensation, the catalogue has both 'Weakest step: Compensation' (runs gym n:5) and 'Five compensation sums' (gym n:5). The default and Standard presets tick both, so the Round runs two identical gym sets.
evidence: Seeded comp 40%: builder default checked [weak, due, concept, gym]; Standard 25 → weak + due + gym + est + steps.
fix: When wl.c==='comp', drop the 'gym' leg from roundPlan (or turn the weak leg into a targeted step-by-step on compensation-heavy kinds).

what: The presets give no feedback. There is no pressed state, and for a new user 'Standard 25' and 'Everything' select the same 24 minutes, so the buttons look broken. 'Quick 10' picks 'Concept + Five step-by-step gases', with no gym, because the priority order is greedy.
evidence: Fresh: Quick 10 → [1,0,0,1,0,0] 10 min; Standard 25 → all 6, 24 min; Everything → all 6, 24 min.
fix: Mark the active preset with aria-pressed. Hide 'Everything' when it equals Standard. For Quick 10, prefer a mix (e.g. gym 3 + est 3 + concept 2 = 8, or weak + due).

what: Edge labels are drawn before the node boxes, so nodes cover them: 'ketoacidosis' shows as 'oacidosis' under Toxic alcohols, and 'phosphate, urate, acids' runs into Albumin. Labels sit at the exact midpoint with no background.
evidence: Select HAGMA on desktop. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T18-desk-web-light-clinical.png
fix: Draw the labels after the nodes, give each a background rect (paint-order stroke with --surface), and nudge labels that overlap a node box.

what: There is a duplicate edge: ['coox','co','measures COHb'] and ['co','coox','needs co-oximetry']. The CO detail card lists Co-oximetry twice, two labels are stacked on one line, and the header counts 77 links where there are 76 distinct pairs.
evidence: Concept web → Carbon monoxide shows two Co-oximetry buttons. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T18-desk-web-co.png
fix: Merge them into one edge, e.g. ['co','coox','SpO₂ blind; co-oximetry measures COHb'].

what: The intro promises 'what it depends on, what it changes', but edges have no direction and the detail card lists all links as one undifferentiated set.
evidence: RENDER.web text vs WEB_EDGES data (no direction field is used in rendering).
fix: Treat [a,b] as a→b ('a feeds b') and split the detail card into 'Builds on' and 'Leads to', with arrowheads on the active edges. Otherwise reword the intro to 'see what it is linked to and why'.

what: 'Compensation rules' and 'Winter's formula' are filed under topic 'kid' (Kidneys). Winter's is respiratory compensation, and the node covers both lungs and kidneys.
evidence: WEB_NODES entries 35–36 (topic 'kid'). Legend colour: green Kidneys.
fix: Move both to 'dis' (Disorders), or add a 'Rules' topic.

what: 'ADH turns methanol and ethylene glycol into formic and glycolic acid.' ADH only makes the aldehydes; aldehyde dehydrogenase makes the acids. Oxalate, the renal toxin, is not mentioned.
evidence: Concept web → Toxic alcohols.
fix: Change it to 'ADH, then ALDH, turn methanol into formic acid and ethylene glycol into glycolic and oxalic acid.'

what: After Enter on a focused node, RENDER.web rebuilds innerHTML and focus drops to <body>, so keyboard users lose their place in the 59-node map.
evidence: Desktop: focus .web-n[data-id=winters], press Enter; document.activeElement is BODY.
fix: After re-render, focus the same .web-n or the detail heading (tabindex=-1).

what: There are about 20 duplicate facts among the 324 cards: ph-1/nph-0, lactate-0/nlac-0, ketones-0/dka-0, preanal-0/tc-bubbles-0, preanal-1/tc-bubbles-1, oxim-2/oxread-0, comp-0/rule-0, comp-1/rule-1/malk-2, nderived-0/rule-4, alkmaint-1/malk-0/vomit-1, sites-1/tc-radial-2, oxim-1/methb-0, alv-1/sp-elder-1, arrest-0/icu-rosc-1, microbes-0/sepsis-0, copd-0/co2vent-2/sp-ohs-2. Each is scheduled separately, which inflates reviews.
evidence: FLASH dump (324 cards).
fix: De-duplicate by normalised back text plus a similar front, keeping the first. The hand-written 'Core rules' cards could replace comp-0/1/2.

what: 'Deck done' persists: leave and come back and you still see the old 'Deck done · 19 of 20' screen instead of a fresh deck or the due count. The card also has no progress bar, only the eyebrow text.
evidence: Finish a deck, go('today'), then go('flash'): the same 'Deck done' text.
fix: On go('flash') with FL.done, rebuild the deck if more than 0 cards are due, or show 'N due now · Another deck'.

what: A shift in progress lives only in memory (SC). A reload or PWA restart loses it, and the tile gives no hint of a half-done shift.
evidence: Leave mid-shift → come back works in-session. Reload → back to the list.
fix: Persist SC (id, i, tried, wrong) in S.scenRun and show 'Resume (decision 3/5)' on the tile.

what: The prompt says 'VBG and bedside ketones' but no ketone value is shown on the slip, so the learner cannot confirm DKA from the data given.
evidence: Shifts → DKA at 3 a.m., decision 1. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T18-desk-scen-dka.png
fix: Add 'Bedside ketones 5.8 mmol/L' to the prompt text, or show bhb on the slip if slip() supports it.

what: The day-2 gas has no sample field, so it is shown as ARTERIAL, while the earlier gases in the same story were venous. Patients recovering from DKA are rarely re-stabbed for an ABG.
evidence: SCENARIOS[1].steps[3].gas has no sample:'v'.
fix: Add sample:'v' and recheck the AG note (AG ≈ 11 with venous HCO₃⁻ 15.8).

what: 'Measure ethanol too (it adds ≈ 1 mOsm per 4.6 mg/dL)' gives a mg/dL factor in an app that uses mmol/L for urea and glucose in the same osmolar gap formula.
evidence: Shifts → Three men, one bottle, decision 4.
fix: Add 'ethanol in mmol/L adds ≈ 1 mOsm/kg per mmol/L (≈ 1.25 empirically); in mg/dL divide by 4.6'.

what: The correct option says 'nebulised bronchodilators' without saying air-driven. BTS advises driving nebulisers with air (with nasal O₂) in hypercapnic COPD, the very trap this shift teaches.
evidence: SCENARIOS copd steps[1] option 1.
fix: Change it to 'air-driven nebulised bronchodilators (with nasal oxygen to target)'.

what: The serial gas options show <kbd>1–4</kbd> numbers, but no key handler exists (only scen and flash have one), so pressing 1–4 does nothing.
evidence: Desktop: open any serial, press '1': SR.ans stays {}.
fix: Add a keydown handler for VIEW==='serial' that mirrors the scen handler (1–4 answer, Enter for Next).

what: Lactate rises 4.2 → 5.5 while the AG barely moves (19 → 19.5) and HCO₃⁻ falls only 0.5. Inconsistent for a teaching series about rising lactate.
evidence: SERIES sep: Cl 104 and Na 138 are constant across all three gases.
fix: At 2 h use HCO₃⁻ about 13.5 and PCO₂ about 28 (Winter's 28 ± 2, pH ≈ 7.31), giving an AG of about 20.5, or keep the lactate rise smaller.

what: full() silently adds albumin 40 g/L to every serial gas that has Na and Cl, and the slip shows it as a measured value. In the sepsis series, assuming a normal albumin is exactly the trap the app teaches elsewhere ('Albumin: correct the gap').
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T18-phone-serial.png shows 'Albumin 40' on each sepsis gas.
fix: Pass the assumed albumin to the AG maths but do not print it, or give the sepsis series a real low albumin (e.g. 28) and ask about the corrected gap.

what: In every serial question the correct option is the longest and most specific, and the distractors are one-word options ('Unchanged', 'Nothing', 'Worse'). This is a length tell; most questions can be answered without reading the gas.
evidence: All SERIES pts have a:0 and the right option is about 3× longer than the others.
fix: Write distractors of matching length with plausible wrong reasoning, e.g. 'Better: the PCO₂ is back in the normal range, so he is less acidotic'.

what: With units set to kPa, the question shows 'PCO₂ 4.7 kPa', but the working silently switches to mmHg: 'Ratio 22 ÷ (0.03 × 35)'. The A–a item shows bare mmHg numbers with no unit in kPa mode.
evidence: S.units='kPa'; estNew() until k==='ph': text 'PCO₂ 4.7 kPa', work '0.03 × 35'.
fix: In kPa mode, write the working as '0.23 × 4.7' and label the A–a inputs with their unit, or convert them.

what: The slider starts at the midpoint, and locking without moving it scores 'close' 24–27% of the time for Winter's, corrected AG and A–a (14% for pH). That inflates the 'gas sense %' shown in Progress.
evidence: Simulated 4,000 items: centre-guess hits winters 193/715, agc 162/683, aa 161/681, ph 168/1216.
fix: Start the thumb at a random position, or require at least one input event before 'Lock it in' is enabled.

what: The rubric says '1–2: pure high-gap' and '< 0.8: added NAGMA', leaving 0.8–1 unclassified. The 'mixed' node says 'outside 0.8–2'. The standard bands are < 0.4 pure NAGMA, 0.4–0.8 mixed, 0.8–2 pure HAGMA, > 2 added alkalosis.
evidence: TEACH[3].rub vs WEB_NODES mixed.
fix: Change the rubric to '0.8–2: a pure high-gap acidosis (DKA nearer 1, lactate nearer 1.6)'.

what: TEACH 'ag' and 'delta' share lesson 'nderived'. renderLesson() and the kit long-press menu use TEACH.find(t=>t.lesson===id), so the Δ ratio teach-back can never be launched from its lesson.
evidence: ui1.js:173 and kit.js:25 use .find, which returns the first match only.
fix: Use filter() and show one button per prompt, or launch the teach pool filtered by lesson.

what: 'Another prompt' picks at random from the due pool and can return the same prompt again. With only 12 prompts this happens often.
evidence: tbSkip → TB=null → random pick, with no exclusion of the current item.
fix: Exclude the current item.c when re-picking.

what: Plurals are wrong: '1 Rounds', '1 gases' in the Progress eyebrow; '1 gases' in heatmap day hints and on the Today mastery card legend (ui1.js:143).
evidence: S.read=1, S.roundsDone=1 → 'MASTERY 13% · 1 ROUNDS · 1 GASES'. Heat hint for 07/11 → '1 gases'. Today mastery legend '1 gases'.
fix: Use a plural helper pl(n,'gas','gases') in ui5.js:305, the heat hint (ui5.js:302) and ui1.js:143.

what: In Quiet mode a finished Shift still says '+25 XP.'. The walker only strips ' · +N XP', and here the XP follows a full stop and a space.
evidence: Walker probe: the text node 'Clean run: every call right first time. +25 XP.' is unchanged after the walker runs. The same string is built at ui5.js:189.
fix: Wrap it: (S.quiet===false?' +'+xp+' XP.':''). Or broaden the MAP regex to /\s*[·.]?\s*\+\d+ XP\.?/g.

what: Streak, Rounds and Reflex badges are awarded only when the Progress screen is rendered. The date stored is the visit date, not the day the condition was met. A 7-day streak that ends before the user opens Progress never earns the badge.
evidence: Seed streak reached 7 days on 07/11 (later 9). The first Progress visit on 13/11 stores badges.streak7='13/11/2026' ('Won 13/11/2026').
fix: Check these badges where the state changes: touchDay() for the streak, roundFinish() for Rounds, reflex session end for reflex4. Store that date.

what: Sessions from the case library and timed sims show raw mode ids in their hint ('case', 'sim') because MODES has no entries for them.
evidence: Hold the 4th spark bar: 'case / 2/5 on 10/11/2026'; another shows 'sim / 3/4 …'.
fix: Add MODES.case={t:'Case library',hidden:true} and MODES.sim={t:'Timed sim',hidden:true} in ui8.js, or map them in the hint.

what: Percentages show for tiny samples ('33% when "guess" (3)') with no caution. The note is static and does not say whether the user is calibrated. Ratings skipped by the user are pushed as {c:undefined}, which eats into the 300-entry cap.
evidence: Seed: sure 70% (10), think 75% (4), guess 33% (3). 'Think' beats 'sure', but nothing is said about it.
fix: Show '—' until n≥5. Add a one-line verdict: 'Overconfident: “sure” is right 70%, aim for 90%+' or 'Well calibrated'. In ui2.js only push when C.conf is set.

what: When two reasons tie, the advice silently picks the first in WHY order (misread), and the bars do not show which reason the advice is for.
evidence: why={misread:3,slip:3,rule:1} → advice only about misreads, with a 43%/43% tie.
fix: When tied, show both pieces of advice, or name the reason: 'Most misses: misread (3) and slip (3).' Require ≥3 tagged misses before giving advice.

where: Progress heat map (.heat i), round pips (.pips), session bar (.sprog, ui2), sim severity bar (.sevbar, ui8)
what: These graphics have no text alternative. Heat squares carry their date and count only in a hold-only data-hint. Pips and progress segments are empty <i> elements, and the severity bar is a bare gradient. Screen readers get nothing.
evidence:
snap-progress.txt: "Last 4 weeks" followed directly by text, with no heat data. The roundbar HTML:
…
fix: Give .heat role="img" with aria-label="Last 4 weeks: studied on N days, M gases", or render a visually hidden list. Give .pips and .sprog role="img" with aria-label="Leg 1 of 3" / "3 of 10 done, 2 right". Give .sevbar role="meter" with aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext ("Severity: worsening").

what: The Round builder uses native browser checkboxes (blue, 13 px, below the 44 px touch target) that break the pixel look. On 360×640 only four legs fit and the Start button is below the fold with no sticky footer, so the user must scroll the sheet to start. On desktop it is a phone-style bottom sheet floating in the middle of the screen.
evidence: Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-builder-360x640-pixel-dark.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-builder-1280x800-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Style checkboxes (appearance:none, 22×22, 2 px border, accent fill with a pixel tick) and make the whole .srow the tap target. Make the button row `position:sticky;bottom:0;background:var(--surface)` inside .sheet. Above 760 px, centre the sheet (`.sheet-scrim{align-items:center}`).

what: (1) 'Off by 9. Answer: 22 mmHg' for a guess of 30: the 'off by' uses the unrounded 21.5 but shows 22, so the arithmetic looks wrong (30 − 22 = 8). (2) The feedback offers 'Shortcut: HCO₃⁻ + 15 = 24 (fine for HCO₃⁻ 10–18)' on a case with HCO₃⁻ 9, which is outside the stated range and outside Winter's band (21.5 ± 2). (3) The close tolerance is stated only for PCO₂ ('± 3 mmHg'). A guess off by 3 on the anion gap was marked ✗.
evidence: Round leg 'Three estimates'. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-round-est-fb0.png
fix: Compute 'off by' from the displayed answer. Show the shortcut only when HCO₃⁻ is 10–18. State the tolerance per item type under the slider.

what: In the middle of a leg, 'Go' calls roundGo(), which starts a new session for the same leg and throws away answers given so far. The label does not say that.
evidence: Code: $('rbGo').onclick=roundGo, and roundGo → startSession(...) for gym/steps.
fix: Hide 'Go' while that leg's view is open, or make it 'Back to leg' and return to the live SS if one exists.

what: Progress has nothing on speed drills (Five-second read 8/12, median), cases and sims done, or lessons by module. After a full evening, a third of what I did does not appear.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-progress-full.png
fix: Add a 'Speed' row (best % and median s per drill), 'Cases 2/16 · sims 1/5', and a module ribbon.

what: '…so a mismatch means a copying error' is ambiguous: a mismatch between what? A gas HCO₃⁻ against the lab total CO₂ differs by 1–2 normally and is not a copying error.
evidence: Concept web → Calculated HCO₃⁻.
fix: Change it to 'The analyser calculates HCO₃⁻ from pH and PCO₂, so if the three written values fail Henderson's check, a number was copied wrongly.'

what: The label 'reports at 37 °C' sits on a link to Calculated HCO₃⁻ only. Temperature affects pH, PCO₂ and PO₂ directly, so this is the weakest link to show.
evidence: WEB_EDGES ['temp','calc',…]. Temperature has only this one link.
fix: Link temp → pco2 ('measured at 37 °C') and temp → odc ('hypothermia shifts left').

what: The VBG is internally inconsistent: pH 7.29 with PCO₂ 30 and HCO₃⁻ 13 gives a Henderson–Hasselbalch pH of 7.26 ([H⁺] 55 vs 51 nmol/L). The app teaches the consistency check elsewhere (Calculated HCO₃⁻ node). Every other scenario and serial gas checks within 0.01.
fix: Use pH 7.26 (then estimated arterial 7.29) or HCO₃⁻ 14.

what: 'COHb 24% in a non-smoker', but the intro never says the workers are non-smokers.
evidence: Shifts → Generator in the camp.
fix: Say 'both non-smokers' in the intro, or change the line to 'far above even a heavy smoker's 10%'.

what: The story 'Fluids, potassium, then fixed-rate insulin' with arrival K⁺ 5.2 implies potassium is given before insulin. At K⁺ 5.2, insulin is not delayed, and JBDS adds no K⁺ to the fluids above 5.5.
evidence: SERIES[0].story with pts[0].g.k = 5.2.
fix: Change it to 'Fluids, then fixed-rate insulin, with potassium added once K⁺ < 5.5.'

what: When albumin > 40 the working reads 'Correction + 0.25 × (40 − 41) = -0.2 → 19.8': a plus sign followed by a negative value, a hyphen instead of a minus sign, and -0.25 rounded to -0.2.
evidence: Example from the kpa.json run: Na 137, Cl 96, HCO₃⁻ 21, alb 41.
fix: Format the signed correction with '−' and one decimal place, e.g. '− 0.25'. Alternatively, keep albumin ≤ 40 in the generator.

what: PaO₂ can be generated as low as 17–21 mmHg on room air in a patient described only by numbers (PaCO₂ 70, A–a 45). This is unrealistic, and a value that low would be a peri-arrest gas.
evidence: Simulation: min PaO₂ 21 in 4,000 items; the code range allows 17.
fix: Keep PaO₂ ≥ 40 (re-roll), or cap the A–a so that PaO₂ stays ≥ 45.

what: The teach-backs list follows TEACH order, not due date. Nothing links to the due item directly. 'Settings & backup' sits oddly inside the Teach-backs card.
evidence: Seed: Anion gap (due) is listed between two not-due items. Buttons: 'Teach one now', 'Settings & backup'.
fix: Sort due first, then by date. Make each due row a button that opens that teach-back. Move 'Settings & backup' to a footer row of the screen.

what: '—  reflex automatic', 'delayed recall' and 'gas sense' have no explanation and no hint. 'Delayed recall' only counts reads of a pattern seen ≥3 days earlier, which nobody would guess.
evidence: Hold any stat: no data-hint on the .stats divs.
fix: Add data-hint to each stat, e.g. 'Delayed recall|Full reads of a pattern you had not seen for 3+ days: the best test of memory.' 'Reflex automatic|Highest level with 20 gases at ≥90% and median ≤8 s.'

where: heat cells and spark bars accessibility

evidence: DOM: .
fix: Add role="img" and aria-label (e.g. '05/11/2026: 14 gases') to each cell, or one visually hidden summary per chart.

what: These views have no back crumb, while speed drills, cases, tools and lessons all have '← Practice' or '← Labs'. On desktop there is no way back except the top tabs.
evidence: go('teach'|'est'|'flash'|'serial'). Shots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T28-teach-390x844-pixel-dark.png etc.
fix: Add the same `.crumbs` with '← Practice' to each renderer.

what: Eleven nodes have only one link (pio2, solub, temp, og, dlac, fixed, uosm, be, lowag, preanal, rhabdo), and some obvious links are missing: co→odc (left shift), sepsis→hagma, rhabdo→aldo/K⁺, vq→rf, be→hagma.

fix: Add co→odc 'left shift', sepsis→hagma 'lactic', vq→rf 'type 1', preanal→pco2/po2 'bubble, delay', be→hagma 'base deficit', solub→pco2 'why CO₂ diffuses easily'.

what: The action step leaves out sodium bicarbonate for the acidosis (pH < 7.3 is the usual trigger in methanol, which reduces formate entry to tissues).
evidence: Shifts → Three men, decision 3.
fix: Add 'IV bicarbonate for pH < 7.3' to the correct option and explanation.

what: Self-grading shows only terse key points. A short model explanation (3–4 sentences) after grading would show what a good teach-back sounds like and make honest ticking easier.
evidence: TEACH items have q and rub only.
fix: Add an 'ans' field and show it under the rubric once Save is pressed (or behind 'See a model answer').

what: Only 12 of 59 concept nodes have a teach-back prompt, so 'Teach it back' is missing from most concept cards. High-yield gaps: DKA, salicylate, CO, RTA/UAG, osmolar gap, base excess, VBG→ABG conversion, Bohr/Haldane.
evidence: TEACH.length 12; WEB_NODES 59.
fix: Add 8–12 prompts for these nodes.

what: On a phone the serial gases stack vertically, so by the third gas the learner scrolls past two full slips to compare them. The point of the feature is the change between gases.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T18-phone-serial.png
fix: Add a compact trend table (time × pH, PCO₂, HCO₃⁻, AG, lactate) with ↑/↓ arrows above the question, and collapse the earlier slips.

what: Finishing gives only a toast ('3 of 3 right') and returns to the list. There is no recap of the trajectory and no prompt to try the matching shift or concept.
evidence: srNext on the last point → toast, then SR=null.
fix: Add a finish card with the trend sparkline, the one-line lesson of the series, and links to the related shift or concept node.

what: The shifts are linear: a wrong turn shows a consequence and then you retry the same step, which does not really branch. One or two true branches per shift (e.g. intubating the salicylate patient on standard settings leads to a worse gas at the next step) would match the 'branching' promise.
evidence: SCENARIOS steps are a flat array.
fix: Allow an option to set next:'stepId' and add one consequence gas per shift.

what: For numeric cards, an optional typed answer (e.g. 'P50 ≈ ?' → 27) before flipping would make recall measurable instead of self-rated.
evidence: FLASH cards are all self-rated.
fix: Add a 'type it' toggle for cards whose back starts with a number, with fuzzy matching ±10%.

what: Put the 15-pattern mastery grid (now only on Today) on Progress too, with each pattern's stage, accuracy and next due date, and explain how mastery % is computed (average spaced-review stage out of 5). The screen called 'Progress' shows mastery only as a number in the eyebrow.
evidence: Progress eyebrow 'Mastery 13%'; the grid is at ui1.js:143.
fix: Reuse the Today grid markup in a 'Patterns' card, plus a 'due on dd/mm/yyyy' small line per tile.

what: In Quiet mode the badges card disappears, so passed module checks are invisible on Progress. Add a plain 'Module checks passed 2/14' line (with dates) that shows in both modes.
evidence: Quiet: no record of module checks on Progress.
fix: A non-gamey card listing modules with check ✓ and date.

what: Show a trend per step (last 20 vs the previous 20 arrows) and a 'Drill' button on each row, so the user acts from the chart itself.
evidence: stepAcc already keeps h[] up to 40 entries.
fix: Add ↑/↓ with the delta, and a row tap → targeted drill.

what: Add a calibration plot (stated confidence vs actual accuracy) and ask for confidence before any feedback (first step), to train metacognition properly.
evidence: Current design asks after the earlier steps' feedback.
fix: Move the picker to the top of the case and keep allAB as the outcome.

what: (11) There is no short daily exam-style leg in the Round.
evidence: Learner session, 13/11/2026
fix: Add a 'Five SBAs' leg (5-option vignettes) to the Round catalogue when an exam goal is set.
